```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

#For this analysis, we took the 225 children samples (1wpp) and the 245 mother samples (preg) available from Viterbi Gut. It represents 208 related pairs of mother and child. We performed InStrain which maps reads against MAGs database to generate one profile per sample. We then compared the profiles between themselves by pair, comparing only within related pairs of mother and child. We found out that 128/208 pairs of mother and child share something (not necessarily the same strain, this is filtered below with InStrain thresholds).

# 1. Packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(stringr)
library(gtsummary)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(ComplexUpset)
library(forcats)  # Needed for fct_reorder()
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(svglite)
```

# 2. Import data
```{r}
# 1. Import transmission data
setwd("your/directory")

instrain_related <- read.delim('Supplementary_table6.tsv') %>%
  mutate(genome = str_replace(genome, '.fasta', '')) %>%
  mutate(genome = str_replace(genome, '.fa', '')) %>%
  mutate(name1 = str_replace(name1, '.sorted.bam', '')) %>%
  mutate(name2 = str_replace(name2, '.sorted.bam', ''))

# 2. Import shotgun data
tax_table_ra <- read.delim("Supplementary_table3.txt", skip = 1)

# Abundance table - relative abundances
  abun_table_ra <- cbind(str_split_fixed(tax_table_ra$clade_name, "\\|[p,c,o,f,g,s,t]__", 8),tax_table_ra)
  abun_table_ra <- as.data.frame(abun_table_ra)
  abun_table_ra[,1] <- str_remove(abun_table_ra[,1], "k__")
  abun_table_ra <- abun_table_ra[-(which(abun_table_ra[,8] == "")),] 
  
# Changing column name of taxonomy
  colnames(abun_table_ra)[1:8] <- c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class","Order","Family","Genus","Species", "SGB")
  abun_table_ra <- abun_table_ra[,-9]
# Clear the column name of samples
  colnames(abun_table_ra) <- str_remove(colnames(abun_table_ra), "_metaphlan")
  colnames(abun_table_ra) <- str_remove(colnames(abun_table_ra), "r")
  colnames(abun_table_ra) <- str_remove(colnames(abun_table_ra), "t") 
  
  
# 3. Import CheckM infos of MAGS
CheckM_C <- read.delim('Supplementary_table7.tsv')
CheckM_M <- read.delim('Supplementary_table8.tsv')
CheckM = rbind(CheckM_C, CheckM_M)
rm(CheckM_C, CheckM_M)


# 4. Import taxonomy of MAGs - MetaPhlan/PhyloPhlan
taxMAGs = read.delim('Supplementary_table9.tsv')
  
taxMAGs <- taxMAGs %>%
  mutate(Unassigned = ifelse(grepl("is close to an SGB not present in the SGB", X.input_bin), # Identify unassigned bins
                             "Not present in DB",
                             ""
                             ),
         X.input_bin = sub(" is close to an SGB not present in the SGB.*$", "", X.input_bin), # Clean bin names (remove trailing message)
         avg_dist = sub("^.*:(\\d+\\.\\d+)$", "\\1", X.u.k._.S.G.F.GBid.taxa_level.taxonomy.avg_dist), # Extract avg_dist (value after last :)
         X.u.k._.S.G.F.GBid.taxa_level.taxonomy.avg_dist = sub(":[0-9\\.]+$", "", X.u.k._.S.G.F.GBid.taxa_level.taxonomy.avg_dist), # Remove avg_dist from taxonomy column
         avg_dist = as.numeric(avg_dist) # Convert to numeric
         ) %>%
  dplyr::rename("MAG" = "X.input_bin",
         "Taxonomy" = "X.u.k._.S.G.F.GBid.taxa_level.taxonomy.avg_dist")
  
taxMAGs <- taxMAGs %>%
  separate(Taxonomy,
           into = c("SGB", "Taxlevel", "Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species", "Strain"),
           sep = "[:|]",
           fill = "right",
           remove = FALSE
           ) %>%
  mutate(across(c(Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species), # Remove prefixes such as k__, p__, c__ etc.
                ~ str_replace(., "^[a-z]__", "")),
         Kingdom = ifelse(Unassigned != "", Unassigned, Kingdom),
         Strain = gsub("^t__", "", Strain) # remove leading "t__"
         ) %>%
  select(-c(Taxonomy, SGB, Taxlevel, Unassigned))

# Modify PhyloPhlan taxonomy to match MetaPhlan taxonomy based on SGB matching
updates <- abun_table_ra %>%
  filter(SGB %in% c("SGB1613", "SGB1626")) %>%
  select(SGB, Species)

taxMAGs <- taxMAGs %>%
  left_join(updates, by = c("Strain" = "SGB"), suffix = c("", ".new")) %>%
  mutate(Species = if_else(!is.na(Species.new), Species.new, Species)) %>%
  select(-Species.new)

taxMAGs <- taxMAGs %>% #replace SGB14824 by SGB14824_group
  mutate(Strain = if_else(Strain == "SGB14824",
                          "SGB14824_group",
                          Strain))

# 5. Merge CheckM and taxMAGs to get the needed infos
CheckM_selected <- CheckM %>% 
  select(Bin.Id, Completeness, Contamination)

genomeTaxonomy <- left_join(taxMAGs, CheckM_selected, by = c("MAG" = "Bin.Id"))
sum(is.na(genomeTaxonomy$Species)) # 4253 not assigned species with PhyloPhlan


# Remove unnecessry objects
rm(tax_table_ra, CheckM_selected, CheckM, taxMAGs, updates)
```

# 3. Same strain filter and adding metadata
```{r}
# filtering dataset to only include strain-sharing comparisons based on instrain recommended cutoffs
instrain_related_samestrain <- instrain_related %>%
  filter(popANI >= 0.99999 & percent_compared >= 0.5)
# There are 131 same strain events

# Remove unnecessary objects
rm(instrain_related)

# Add sample and taxonomy information to strain-sharing events
instrain_related_samestrain <- instrain_related_samestrain %>%
  left_join(genomeTaxonomy %>% 
              select(MAG, Completeness, Contamination, Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species, Strain), 
            by = c('genome' = 'MAG')) 
sum(is.na(instrain_related_samestrain$Strain)) # 24 transmitted MAGs for which the taxonomy has not been assigned


# Add VG_ID column by extracting the number and appending it to 'VG'
instrain_related_samestrain <- instrain_related_samestrain %>%
  mutate(VG_ID = paste0("VG", gsub("^.*([0-9]{3}).*$", "\\1", name1)))

# Add some metadata
Incv <- read_excel("VG_metadata_inc.xlsx")
w1ppv <- read_excel("VG_metadata_1wpp.xlsx")

Incv_selected = Incv %>%
  select(VG_ID, classif)

w1ppv_selected <- w1ppv %>%
  distinct(VG_ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(VG_ID, howborn, ATB_med_M, ATB_med_C)

# Add antibiotics = yes for all c-section births
w1ppv_selected <- w1ppv_selected %>%
  mutate(ATB_med_M = case_when(howborn %in% c("Planned cesarian section", "Unplanned cesarian section") ~ "Yes",
    TRUE ~ ATB_med_M  # keep original value otherwise
    ))

# Add antibiotics = no for all the NA values
w1ppv_selected <- w1ppv_selected %>%
  mutate(ATB_med_M = if_else(is.na(ATB_med_M), "No", ATB_med_M))

instrain_related_samestrain = left_join(instrain_related_samestrain, Incv_selected, by = "VG_ID")
instrain_related_samestrain = left_join(instrain_related_samestrain, w1ppv_selected, by = "VG_ID")

rm(Incv_selected, w1ppv_selected)

# Reorder columns in the dataframe
instrain_related_samestrain <- instrain_related_samestrain %>%
  select(genome, name1, name2, VG_ID, howborn, classif, ATB_med_M, ATB_med_C, Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species, Strain, everything())

# Number of SGB (~ strain) per Species
species_multiple_strains <- instrain_related_samestrain %>%
  filter(!is.na(Strain)) %>%           # ignore NA strains
  dplyr::group_by(Species) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_strains = n_distinct(Strain)) %>%
  filter(n_strains >= 2) %>%           # keep only Species with ≥ 2 strains
  dplyr::pull(Species)
print(species_multiple_strains) 

rm(species_multiple_strains)
```


# 4. Representativeness of the dereplicated MAGs used for transmission events
## 4.1 Children's MAGs
```{r}
CoverM = read.delim("Supplementary_table10.txt")

# Remove last rows which are not useful
CoverM = CoverM[-c(226:229),]

# Rename column
CoverM = CoverM %>%
  dplyr::rename(Coverage = Percentage.reads.Mapped.on.representative.MAGs..dereplicated.)

# Remove % and convert to numeric
CoverM$Coverage <- as.numeric(sub("%", "", CoverM$Coverage))

# Calculate mean coverage
mean_coverage <- mean(CoverM$Coverage)

# Map the coverage
coverm = ggplot(CoverM, aes(x = Sample, y = Coverage)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "black") + #, width = 0.2
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean_coverage, color = "red") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Percentage of reads mapping on representative dereplicated MAGs",
       x = "Sample",
       y = "Mapping percentage") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.length.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
        plot.title = element_blank())

rm(CoverM, mean_coverage, coverm)
```

# 5. Transmitted bacteria within related pairs
```{r}
unique_rows <- unique(instrain_related_samestrain$VG_ID)
length(unique_rows)
print(unique_rows)
# There are 59 pairs of related mother and child who share at least 1 same strain

table(instrain_related_samestrain$Genus)
table(instrain_related_samestrain$Species)
table(instrain_related_samestrain$Strain)

# Create a frequency plot for the shared species within related dyads
shared_species = instrain_related_samestrain %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Species, Species, function(x) -length(x)))) +  # Reorder by frequency
    geom_bar(fill = "grey", color = "black") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, face="italic")) +
    labs(title = NULL, # "Frequency of transmitted species within related pais
         x = "Transmitted species within related pairs",
         y = "Frequency")

unique_rows <- unique(instrain_related_samestrain$Species)
length(unique_rows)
print(unique_rows)

# Create a frequency plot for the shared strains within related dyads
# Create a new label column
instrain_related_samestrain <- instrain_related_samestrain %>%
  mutate(Strain_Species = paste0(Species, " (", Strain, ")"))

# Plot with the new combined label
shared_strain <- instrain_related_samestrain %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Strain_Species, Strain_Species, function(x) -length(x)))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "grey", color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, face="italic")) +
  labs(title = NULL, #"Frequency of transmitted strain within related pairs"
       x = "Transmitted strains within related pairs",
       y = "Number of transmission events")

unique_rows <- unique(instrain_related_samestrain$Strain_Species)
length(unique_rows)
print(unique_rows)
table(instrain_related_samestrain$Strain_Species)

# Create a frequency plot for the shared genus within related dyads
shared_genus = instrain_related_samestrain %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Genus, Genus, function(x) -length(x)))) +  # Reorder by frequency
    geom_bar(fill = "grey", color = "black") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, face="italic")) +
    labs(title = "Frequency of transmitted genus within related pairs",
         x = "Transmitted genus within related pairs",
         y = "Number of transmission events")

# All transmission events
transmission_counts_all <- instrain_related_samestrain %>%
  group_by(VG_ID) %>%  # Group by mother-child pair (VG_ID)
  dplyr::summarise(n_transmissions = n()) # Count the number of rows per pair

mean_n_transmission <- mean(transmission_counts_all$n_transmissions, na.rm = TRUE)
print(mean_n_transmission)  # 2.22 strains transmitted on average in a related pair

transmission_counts_byclassif <- instrain_related_samestrain %>%
  group_by(VG_ID, classif) %>%  # Group by mother-child pair (VG_ID) and classif
  dplyr::summarise(n_transmissions = n(), .groups = "drop")  # Count transmissions and keep classif

avg_transmission_by_classif <- transmission_counts_byclassif %>%
  group_by(classif) %>%  # Group by classif
  dplyr::summarise(avg_transmissions = mean(n_transmissions), .groups = "drop")  # Calculate mean

# Remove unecessary objects
rm(unique_rows,shared_species, shared_strain, shared_genus, transmission_counts_all, mean_n_transmission, transmission_counts_byclassif, avg_transmission_by_classif)
```


## 5.1 Plot the transmitted strains in function of their relative abundance in each individual
```{r}
# Reformat the abundance table to have all the strains as columns, then a column "Sample", then a column "individual"
# abun_table_ra_1 <- abun_table_ra %>%
#   mutate(Strain_Species = paste0(Species, " (", SGB, ")")) # Create a new label column

abun_table_ra_1 = abun_table_ra
rownames(abun_table_ra_1) = abun_table_ra_1$SGB

# rownames(abun_table_ra_1) = abun_table_ra_1$Strain_Species
abun_table_ra_1 = abun_table_ra_1[,-c(1:8)]
# abun_table_ra_1 = abun_table_ra_1[,-473]

abun_table_ra_t = t(abun_table_ra_1)
abun_table_ra_t = as.data.frame(abun_table_ra_t)
abun_table_ra_t$Sample = rownames(abun_table_ra_t)

abun_table_ra_t <- abun_table_ra_t %>%
  mutate(individual = case_when(startsWith(Sample, "C") ~ "Child",
                                startsWith(Sample, "M") ~ "Mother",
                                TRUE ~ NA_character_
                                ))

# Filter the abundance table to transmitted strains
transmitted_strains <- instrain_related_samestrain$Strain
transmitted_ids <- transmitted_strains[transmitted_strains %in% colnames(abun_table_ra_t)]
setdiff(transmitted_strains, transmitted_ids) # only NAs so all good

ab_transmitted <- abun_table_ra_t %>%
  select(Sample, individual, all_of(transmitted_ids))

# Convert to long format
ab_long <- ab_transmitted %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(transmitted_ids),
               names_to = "Strain",
               values_to = "Abundance"
               )

# Compute averages for infants and mothers
ab_summary <- ab_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Strain, individual) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_ab = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(individual = ifelse(individual == "Child", "Child", "Mother"))

# Add species taxonomy from MetaPhlan
ab_summary <- ab_summary %>%
  left_join(abun_table_ra %>% select(Species, SGB),
            by = c("Strain" = "SGB")
            )

ab_summary <- ab_summary %>%
  mutate(Strain_Species = paste0(Species, " (", Strain, ")")) # Create a new label column

# Prepare for left–right plot (mirrored bars)
ab_plot <- ab_summary %>%
  mutate(mean_ab_plot = ifelse(individual == "Child", -mean_ab, mean_ab))

# Plot
abund_plot = ggplot(ab_plot, aes(x = mean_ab_plot, y = Strain_Species, fill = individual)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(mean_ab, 2),
                x = ifelse(individual == "Child", mean_ab_plot - 1, mean_ab_plot + 1)),
            size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = abs) +   # show positive labels on x-axis
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Child" = "#E5F0DB", "Mother" = "#E1EBF6")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = NULL, # "Relative Abundance of Transmitted Strains"
       x = "Relative Abundance (%)",
       y = "") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
        )

# Remove unecessary objects
rm(ab_long, ab_plot, ab_summary, ab_transmitted, abun_table_ra_t, abun_table_ra_1, transmitted_ids, transmitted_strains, abund_plot)
```

## 5.2  Relative abundance comparison between mother and child
```{r}
# Reformat the abundance table to have all the strains as columns, then a column "Sample", then a column "individual"
abun_table_ra_1 = abun_table_ra
rownames(abun_table_ra_1) = abun_table_ra_1$SGB

abun_table_ra_1 = abun_table_ra_1[,-c(1:8)] # Remove all the taxonomy columns

abun_table_ra_t = t(abun_table_ra_1)
abun_table_ra_t = as.data.frame(abun_table_ra_t)
abun_table_ra_t$Sample = rownames(abun_table_ra_t)

abun_table_ra_t <- abun_table_ra_t %>%
  mutate(individual = case_when(startsWith(Sample, "C") ~ "Child",
                                startsWith(Sample, "M") ~ "Mother",
                                TRUE ~ NA_character_
                                ))

# Convert to long format
ab_long <- abun_table_ra_t %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("SGB"),
               names_to = "Strain",
               values_to = "Abundance"
               )

ab_long = ab_long[,-c(1:11)] #remove eukaryotes

# Compute averages abundance for infants and mothers
ab_summary <- ab_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Strain, individual) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_ab = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(individual = ifelse(individual == "Child", "Child", "Mother"))

# filter the dataset for the top 50 strains in each individual
top50_each <- ab_summary %>%
  dplyr::group_by(individual) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(mean_ab, n = 50, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

top_strains_union <- top50_each %>%
  distinct(Strain)

ab_summary_filt <- ab_summary %>%
  semi_join(top_strains_union, by = "Strain")

# Add species taxonomy from MetaPhlan
ab_summary_filt <- ab_summary_filt %>%
  left_join(abun_table_ra %>% select(Species, SGB),
            by = c("Strain" = "SGB")
            )

# Create a new label column
ab_summary_filt <- ab_summary_filt %>%
  mutate(Strain_Species = paste0(Species, " (", Strain, ")"))

# Prepare for left–right plot (mirrored bars)
ab_plot <- ab_summary_filt %>%
  mutate(mean_ab_plot = ifelse(individual == "Child", -mean_ab, mean_ab))

# Highlight the transmitted strains
transmitted_strains <- instrain_related_samestrain$Strain
transmitted_ids <- transmitted_strains[transmitted_strains %in% colnames(abun_table_ra_t)]

library(forcats)
ab_plot <- ab_plot %>%
  mutate(is_highlight = Strain %in% transmitted_ids) %>%
  group_by(Strain_Species) %>%
  mutate(any_highlight = any(is_highlight),
         total_ab = sum(abs(mean_ab_plot), na.rm = TRUE)  # for ordering within blocks
         ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Strain_Species = fct_reorder(Strain_Species, any_highlight + total_ab / max(total_ab, na.rm = TRUE)) # Put highlighted Strain_Species first, then order by total abundance
  )

# Plot
ggplot(ab_plot, aes(x = mean_ab_plot, y = Strain_Species, fill = individual)) +
  geom_col(aes(alpha = is_highlight), width = 0.7) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 0.6, `TRUE` = 1), guide = "none") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(mean_ab, 3),
                x = ifelse(individual == "Child", mean_ab_plot - 2, mean_ab_plot + 2)),
            size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = abs) +   # show positive labels on x-axis
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Child" = "#E5F0DB", "Mother" = "#E1EBF6")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = NULL, # "Relative Abundance of Transmitted Strains"
       x = "Relative Abundance (%)",
       y = "") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
        )

# Remove unecessary objects
rm(ab_long, ab_plot, ab_summary, abun_table_ra_t, abun_table_ra_1, ab_summary_filt, transmitted_ids, transmitted_strains)

```

# 6. Get metadata for the 208 pairs of mother and child
```{r}
metadata = read.delim("VG_metadata.tsv")
pairs = read.table("Supplementary_table12.txt", header = FALSE)

# Check that the classif does not differ between inclusion visit and 1wpp visit
metadata %>%
  group_by(VG_ID) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(classif) > 1) %>%
  select(VG_ID, classif) %>%
  distinct()

# Get the VG_ID for the shared pairs
pairs <- pairs %>%
  mutate(VG_ID = paste0("VG", str_extract(V1, "\\d{3}")))  # Extracts the 3-digit number and prepends 'VG'
pairs = as.data.frame(pairs[,-c(1:2)])
pairs = pairs %>%
  dplyr::rename("VG_ID" = "pairs[, -c(1:2)]")

# Add a column "Considered for analysis" to metadata. Value = Yes if the pair was one of the 208 ones used for InStrain analysis
metadata$InStrain <- ifelse(metadata$VG_ID %in% pairs$VG_ID, "Yes", "No")
table(metadata$InStrain) #624 Yes => divided by 3 (because 2 lines M + C for 1wpp and 1 line M for inc) = 208, so all good
metadata_InStrain = metadata %>%
  filter(InStrain == "Yes")

# Add a transmission column to metadata_InStrain Value = Yes if there is at least 1 transmission event for that pair
metadata_InStrain$Transmission <- ifelse(metadata_InStrain$VG_ID %in% instrain_related_samestrain$VG_ID, "Yes", "No")
table(metadata_InStrain$Transmission) # 177 Yes => divided by 3 = 59 pairs have transmission so all good

# Add a Transmission_count column to metadata_InStrain to know how many strains have been transmitted per pair
transmission_counts_df <- instrain_related_samestrain %>%
  group_by(VG_ID) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Transmission_count = n()) %>%
  ungroup()
metadata_InStrain <- metadata_InStrain %>%
  left_join(transmission_counts_df, by = "VG_ID")
metadata_InStrain$Transmission_count[is.na(metadata_InStrain$Transmission_count)] <- 0 #for those without transmission
rm(transmission_counts_df)

# plot the percentage of pairs sharing at least 1 strain
percentage <- metadata_InStrain %>%
  dplyr::count(Transmission) %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * n / sum(n))

perc = ggplot(percentage, aes(x = Transmission, y = percentage, fill = Transmission)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.5) +
  ylab("Percentage of related pairs") +
  xlab("Strain transmission") +
  ggtitle("Percentage of related pairs sharing at least one strain") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "#1f78b4", "No" = "#33a02c")) +
  theme_minimal()

# Remove unecessary objects
rm(perc, percentage, pairs)
```

# 7. Strain Transmission in related pairs in function of the nutritional group
## 7.1 Frequency of shared strains in related pairs by classif
```{r}
# Check if the number of transmitted strain is different between the nutritional groups
# Create a table of observed frequencies
transmission_counts_classif <- instrain_related_samestrain %>% 
  group_by(classif) %>%  # Group by both mother-child pair and nutritional group
  dplyr::summarise(Sharing_events_n = n(), .groups = "drop")  # Count transmission events

# Calculate the expected number of transmissions per classification group (the distribution is not equal across all groups)
# Define proportions
expected_proportions_df <- metadata_InStrain %>%
  dplyr::distinct(VG_ID, classif) %>%
  dplyr::count(classif) %>%  # Count the number of occurrences of each classif
    mutate(proportion = n / sum(n))  # Calculate the proportion for each class

transmission_counts_classif <- transmission_counts_classif %>%
  left_join(expected_proportions_df, by = "classif") %>%
  mutate(Expected_sharing_event_n = (sum(Sharing_events_n) * proportion))  # Total counts * expected proportion

sum(transmission_counts_classif$Expected_sharing_event_n) # 131, so it's correct, it's the number of transmission events
sum(transmission_counts_classif$proportion) # 1, so it's correct, it's 100% of the related pairs sharing at least 1 strain

# Chi-square test
chi_test_fre <- chisq.test(transmission_counts_classif$Sharing_events_n, p = transmission_counts_classif$proportion)
print(chi_test_fre)
p_value = chi_test_fre$p.value

# Frequency of sharing events between nutritional groups
fre_shared_strain = ggplot(instrain_related_samestrain, aes(x = classif, fill = classif)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Normally nourished" = "darkgoldenrod1", "Overnourished" = "coral1", "Undernourished" = "palegreen")) +
  geom_bar(color = "black", width = 0.2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Frequency of transmitted strain in related pairs in function of nutritional groups",
       x = "Nutritional group",
       y = "Frequency of transmitted strain") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  annotate("text", x = 2, y = 62,  # Set y position inside the range
           label = paste("p =", signif(p_value, 3)), 
           size = 5)

# Frequency of sharing events between nutritional groups by species
fre_shared_strain_all = ggplot(instrain_related_samestrain, aes(x = classif, fill = classif)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Normally nourished" = "darkgoldenrod1", "Overnourished" = "coral1", "Undernourished" = "palegreen")) +
  geom_bar(color = "black", width = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ Species) + #scales = "free_y"
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
  labs(title = "Frequency of transmitted strain in related pairs in function of nutritional groups",
       x = "Nutritional group",
       y = "Frequency of transmitted strain") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## 7.2 Proportion of shared strains in related pairs by classif
```{r}
# Check if the proportion of related pairs having at least 1 transmitted strain is statistically different between the nutritional groups

# Define the observed counts
  # Get the unique VG_ID rows and then create a table of 'classif' for these unique VG_IDs
  observed_counts <- instrain_related_samestrain %>%
    dplyr::distinct(VG_ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%  # Keep only one row per VG_ID
    pull(classif) %>%  # Pull the 'classif' column as a vector
    table()  # Create a table for the unique 'classif' values
  print(observed_counts)
  
  observed_counts_df = as.data.frame(observed_counts)
  observed_counts_df = observed_counts_df %>%
    dplyr::rename("classif" = ".")

observed_counts_df = observed_counts_df %>%
  mutate(Prop = observed_counts_df$Freq*100/expected_proportions_df$n)

# Perform the Chi-square test
chi_test <- chisq.test(observed_counts, p = expected_proportions_df$proportion)
print(chi_test)
p_value = chi_test$p.value

print(expected_proportions_df$n)
print(observed_counts)

# Perform pairwise proportions test
# Make sure the vectors are named
x <- observed_counts_df$Freq
n <- expected_proportions_df$n
names(x) <- observed_counts_df$classif
names(n) <- observed_counts_df$classif

pairwise_test_result <- pairwise.prop.test(x = x,  # Number of transmitted strains (successes)
                                           n = n,  # Total number of pairs
                                           p.adjust.method = "bonferroni"
                                           )
print(pairwise_test_result)

# Convert the matrix of p-values into a tidy format
pairwise_res_df <- as.data.frame(pairwise_test_result$p.value)  

pval_df <- pairwise_res_df %>%
  mutate(group1 = rownames(pairwise_res_df)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-group1, names_to = "group2", values_to = "p") %>%
  filter(!is.na(p))   # keep only real comparisons

# make it compatible with stat_pvalue_manual for the graph below
pval_df <- pval_df %>%
  mutate(y.position = seq(max(observed_counts_df$Prop)*1.05,
                          length.out = n(),
                          by = max(observed_counts_df$Prop)*0.1)) %>%
  mutate(p_label = sprintf("%.3f", p))  

# Proportion of shared events in function of nutritional group
pal_muac = c("Normally nourished" = "#f7bf83",
             "Overnourished" = "#83f7bf",
             "Undernourished" = "#f78583")

prop_shared_strain = ggplot(observed_counts_df, aes(x = classif, y = Prop, fill = classif)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(pal_muac)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Normally nourished" = "NN",
                              "Overnourished"      = "ON",
                              "Undernourished"     = "UN")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Nutritional status",
       y = "Percentage of pairs sharing at least one strain") +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(pval_df,
                     label = "p_label",   # show p-values labels
                     tip.length = 0.01,   # length of bracket lines
                     size = 4             # text size
                     )
```

## 7.6 Correlation between strain abundance and the transmission
```{r}
# Get the number of transmission events per strain
instrain_related_samestrain <- instrain_related_samestrain %>%
  group_by(Strain) %>%                 # Group by Strain
  dplyr::mutate(Transmission_Count_st = n()) %>%   # Count occurrences and add as new column
  ungroup()

transmission_data <- instrain_related_samestrain %>%
  distinct(Strain, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%  # Keep only one row per SGB
  select(Strain, Species, Strain_Species, Transmission_Count_st)  # Select relevant columns

transmission_data <- transmission_data %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Strain)) # Remove all the non taxonomically assigned transmission events

# Compute the average abundance per species
avg_abun_mother <- abun_table_ra %>%
  select(1:8, starts_with("MPST")) # Take the first 8 variables + only the mothers

avg_abun_mother = avg_abun_mother %>%
  rowwise() %>%  # Treat each row separately
  dplyr::mutate(Average_Abundance = mean(c_across(9:ncol(avg_abun_mother)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%  # Calculate mean across abundance columns
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(Species, SGB, Average_Abundance)  # Keep taxonomy columns + new average column

# Merge the datasets 
merged_data = left_join(transmission_data, avg_abun_mother, by = c("Strain" = "SGB"))
merged_data = merged_data %>%
  select(-Species.y) %>%
  rename("Species" = "Species.x")

# Correlation test between transmission and abundance
correlation_test <- cor.test(merged_data$Transmission_Count_st, merged_data$Average_Abundance, method = "spearman")
print(correlation_test)
p_value = correlation_test$p.value
rho = 0.4435366

corr = ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = Average_Abundance, y = Transmission_Count_st)) +
  geom_point(color = "black", size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red", se = FALSE) + 
  labs(title = NULL, # "Correlation between transmission events and relative abundance in maternal samples"
       x = "Mean relative abundance in maternal samples",
       y = "Transmission events") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16)) +
 annotate("text", x = 6, y = 10,
           label = paste("p-value =", signif(p_value, 3), "\nρ =", signif(rho, 3)), 
           size = 6, color = "red")

# Try removing the outlier Segatella copri SGB1626
merged_data_sc <- merged_data %>% 
  filter(Strain != "SGB1626")

correlation_test_sc <- cor.test(merged_data_sc$Transmission_Count_st, merged_data_sc$Average_Abundance, method = "spearman")
print(correlation_test_sc)
p_value_sc = correlation_test_sc$p.value # 0.01
rho_sc = 0.4365495

corr_sc = ggplot(merged_data_sc, aes(x = Average_Abundance, y = Transmission_Count_st)) +
  geom_point(color = "black", size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red", se = FALSE) +  
  labs(title = NULL, #"Correlation between transmission events and relative abundance in maternal samples"
       x = "Mean relative abundance in maternal samples",
       y = "Transmission events") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16)) +
 annotate("text", x = 1.3, y = 15,
           label = paste("p-value =", signif(p_value_sc, 3), "\nρ =", signif(rho_sc, 3)), 
           size = 6, color = "red")
```

## 8.1 Effect of antibiotics use on strain transmission
```{r}
# Test whether antibiotics consumption alter the transmission or not
reduced_metadata = metadata_InStrain %>%
  filter(Visit == "W1") %>%
  filter(individual == "Mother")

chi_test <- chisq.test(x = reduced_metadata$ATB_med_M, y = reduced_metadata$Transmission)
print(chi_test)
p_value = chi_test$p.value

# Summarize the data to get percentages to plot
plot_data <- reduced_metadata %>%
  group_by(ATB_med_M, Transmission) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Proportion = Count / sum(Count) * 100,
         Label = paste0(Count, " (", round(Proportion, 1), "%)"))

# Total summary
total_N <- nrow(reduced_metadata)
total_trans <- sum(reduced_metadata$Transmission == "Yes")
total_trans_pct <- round(total_trans / total_N * 100, 1)

atb = ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = ATB_med_M, y = Count, fill = Transmission)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Label),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            color = "black", size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "#a7d3f0", "No" = "#f0c4a7")) +
  labs(x = "Maternal antibiotic exposure",
       y = "Number of dyads",
       fill = "Transmission of strain") +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 162,
           label = paste0("Chi-sq p-value = ", signif(p_value, 3)),
           size = 4, fontface = "italic") + 
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 155,
           label = paste0("Total N = ", total_N,
                          " | Transmitting dyads = ", total_trans,
                          " (", total_trans_pct, "%)"),
           size = 3.5, hjust = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom")

# Remove unnecessary objects
rm(plot_data, chi_test, p_value, atb, total_N, total_trans, total_trans_pct)
```

```{r}
      add_overall(last = TRUE) %>%
      add_p() %>%
      bold_labels()
```

## 8.3 Effect of mode of delivery on transmission
```{r}
# Create the plot for frequency of transmission by mode of delivery
table(reduced_metadata$howborn, reduced_metadata$Transmission) #all transmission events occur in vaginally born babies (no c-section)

counts <- reduced_metadata %>% 
  dplyr::count(howborn_combined)

stat.test <- reduced_metadata %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(Transmission_count ~ howborn_combined
                       p.adjust.method = "BH"
                       ) %>%
  add_y_position() %>%
  mutate(pval_label = paste0("p-value = ", signif(p.adj, 3), " ", p.adj.signif))
  

mod_plot <- ggplot(reduced_metadata, aes(x = howborn_combined, y = Transmission_count)) +
  geom_violin(fill = "gray80", color = NA, trim = FALSE) +  # violin plot
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", outlier.shape = NA) +  # boxplot overlay
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.6, color = "black") +  # jittered points
  scale_x_discrete(labels = paste0(counts$howborn_combined, " (n=", counts$n, ")")) +
  labs(x = "Delivery mode", y = "Number of strains transmitted per dyad") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.title.x = element_blank()
        ) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "pval_label", tip.length = 0.01, step.increase = 0.05) 

rm(counts, stat.test, mod_plot)
```

```{r}
# Mean number of transmitted strains per dyad by maternal nutritional status

                     p.adjust.methods = "BH",
```

# 9. Correlation between number of strains per species and transmission rate
```{r}
# Total strains per species
total_strains <- abun_table_ra %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Species, SGB) %>%
  dplyr::count(Species, name = "n_total_strains")

# Transmitted strains per species
trans_strains <- instrain_related_samestrain %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Species, Strain) %>%
  dplyr::count(Species, name = "n_transmitted_strains")

# Combine
species_df <- total_strains %>%
  left_join(trans_strains, by = "Species") %>%
  mutate(n_transmitted_strains = replace_na(n_transmitted_strains, 0),
         transmitted = n_transmitted_strains > 0
         )

# logistic regression: Are species with more strains more likely to be transmitted at least once?
model <- glm(transmitted ~ n_total_strains,
             data = species_df,
             family = binomial)

summary(model)

# predicted probabilities
predict(model,
        newdata = data.frame(n_total_strains = c(1, 3, 5, 10)),
        type = "response")

library(broom)

stats_lab <- tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term == "n_total_strains") %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      "OR = ", round(estimate, 2),
      " (95% CI ", round(conf.low, 2), "–", round(conf.high, 2), ")\n",
      "p = ", signif(p.value, 2)
    )
  )

ggplot(species_df,
       aes(x = n_total_strains, y = transmitted)) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0.05, width = 0, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "glm",
              method.args = list(family = "binomial"),
              se = TRUE) +
  annotate("text",
           x = 4, y = 2.3,
           label = stats_lab$label,
           size = 3) +
  labs(x = "Number of strains per species",
       y = "Species transmitted (yes/no)") +
  theme_bw()
```
